gates.clinical_rule: validation-mean completion service not lower, patients lost not higher, manufacturing ineligibility not higher than the anchor arm
gates.ranking_rule: Leave-one-state-seed-out. Fit on the states of all but one generation seed, predict the ladder ranking on the held-out seed. Held-out top-1 >= 50% (chance = 1/11 = 9.1%), pairwise >= 70%, and the fitted model must beat the STATE-BLIND predictor (always the globally best constant rung) by at least 5 points on every held-out fold. Thresholds frozen before the run.
gates.state_dependence_rule: PRIMARY criterion. Prospective value of state-dependence (per-state arm chosen on the discovery stream, scored on validation, constant chosen the same way) must be at least 0.5% of anchor cost -- roughly 100x the Stage F1 attribution noise floor of +/-0.001-0.004% -- and the best arm must be strictly interior in at least 30% of states. The in-sample oracle is never admissible: on Stage E2 it read +0.0054% while the honest out-of-sample value was -0.083%.

experimental_role: development-only Stage E4 held-out-seed ranking screen; evaluation-only, no training of any deployed policy. Tests whether the per-state optimum is PREDICTABLE from features observable at decision time, which E2b/E3 did not establish.
name: continuous_overtime_critic_ranking_e4
